summary: Phase 7 Admin Control Plane (ADR-014) — frontend-only E2E run against the public preview. 14/15 of the required Phase 7 flows verified GREEN on the UI (nav 10 items, /admin→/admin/overview redirect, Overview 5 metrics + activity, Organizations search + suspend/reactivate, KYB queue + correction/approve + Correction-requested label, Users list + self/other suspend guard, Roles read-only + MFA-required, Config save + reset, Feature flag toggle + confirm + cancel + note, Security page, Audit page with events + CSV export, denial screens for procops/buyer, mobile 390px shell). One CRITICAL frontend bug found that affects every admin action returning 204 No Content (KYB decisions, org suspend/reactivate, user suspend/reactivate) — the API client always calls res.json() so users see an alert `Failed to execute 'json' on 'Response': Unexpected end of JSON input` even though the backend successfully applied the change. Confirmed via server-side API checks that state DOES transition (KYB REJECTED→CORRECTION_REQUIRED→IN_REVIEW→VERIFIED, org suspended, config/flag updates, audit rows written). A few minor issues also noted below.

ui_bugs.component: lib/api/client.ts `call()` (used by reviewKyb, suspendUser, reactivateUser, restrictOrg, liftOrg — any 204-returning admin action)
ui_bugs.issue: On success, `call()` unconditionally does `await res.json()`. Backend returns 204 No Content for these endpoints, so JSON.parse throws SyntaxError and the caller renders an InlineAlert reading `Failed to execute 'json' on 'Response': Unexpected end of JSON input`. The action itself DOES persist (verified via GET /api/admin/kyb-queue and /api/admin/audit). Fix: `if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;` before `res.json()`, or check content-length/content-type. Reproduced on: KYB Approve, KYB Reject, KYB Request-correction, Org Suspend (Dev Buyer Co), Org Reactivate, User Suspend (Dev Buyer).

`data-testid="admin-audit-search"` is on the Search *button*, not on any input. The task hint said 'search with action=org.kyb.review returns matching events only' — the correct input is the unlabelled `Action (e.g. org.kyb.review)` field. Consider putting the data-testid on the Action input (e.g. `admin-audit-action`) so E2Es targeting `admin-audit-search` as the query input work. Also, date filters use native HTML `<input type=datetime-local>` (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than the platform's design system calendar.

Typing `demo.admin` into `admin-users-search` did not filter the users list (all 16 users remained). Either the search input has no onChange wiring, or it requires a submit click. `admin-users-search-form` exists suggesting submit-on-Enter; but without a submit affordance the value doesn't apply on input. Please debounce-filter on input, or add a Search button/testid.

The user sheet for demo.admin (viewed by demo.admin) still renders the `admin-user-suspend` button. Server-side guard likely exists (per ADR ruling) but the frontend never hides/disables the control on the acting user. Also, clicking Suspend on self showed the same JSON parse alert rather than a friendly 'You cannot suspend yourself' message. Recommend hiding the suspend form when `user.id === currentUserId`.

After suspending Dev Buyer Co and reactivating it, `admin-org-audit` still shows `No administrative events for this organization.` Audit events for org.suspend/org.lift do not appear in the per-org history section (though they ARE in the global /admin/audit page). The section title implies per-org audit trail — needs backend join or client filter fix.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend shows red error alert on every successful decision because of the 204+json() bug. UX-wise the reviewer thinks the decision failed and often re-clicks. Fortunately backend enforces state-machine so the second click returns 409 (also surfaced as JSON-parse). The state DOES transition on the first click.
Same 204+json() bug — success looks like failure in the UI.

issues: Uses browser-default datetime-local pickers instead of a design-system calendar; low visual consistency with rest of admin.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: `apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts:85` — `return (await res.json()) as T;` will throw on any 204/empty backend response. Multiple Phase-7 admin action endpoints return 204, causing spurious error alerts and misleading users into believing decisions failed. Guard with `if (res.status === 204 || res.headers.get('content-length') === '0') return undefined as T;` before `res.json()`.
AdminUsersPage.tsx: the search input appears to not filter on change; add debounce-driven refetch or ensure form submit on Enter triggers `load()`.
AdminUsersPage.tsx / AdminUsersSheet: no client-side guard against self-suspend — the ADR says the backend blocks it, but the UI should hide/disable the suspend form when `user.id === currentUserId`.

AdminOrgDetailPage.tsx `admin-org-audit`: expected per-org admin activity (suspend/lift, config changes affecting the org) is not populated. Either fetch scoped audit rows for this org or remove the section.

AdminAuditPage.tsx: `data-testid="admin-audit-search"` is on the submit button while the actual query input has no testid — inconsistent naming. Native datetime-local pickers deviate from platform calendar component.

Positive: AdminKybReviewPage correctly forces reasonCode=CORRECTION_REQUIRED for the Request-correction path and requires a note; StatusPill correctly overrides REJECTED→'Correction requested' label when reason_code is CORRECTION_REQUIRED; signed document URLs contain `sig=`.

Positive: AdminShell.NAV contains exactly the 10 required entries with correct testids; RBAC denial screens are friendly (no JSON 403 leaks); Roles page renders read-only permission matrix with no mutating buttons.
action_items: Fix apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts to handle 204/empty responses — this alone eliminates the false-error alerts on KYB decisions, org suspend/lift, and user suspend/reactivate.
Wire up `admin-users-search` input to actually filter (debounced) or add explicit submit handling.
Hide/disable the suspend form on the acting admin's own user sheet (self-suspend guard).
Populate `admin-org-audit` with the org's admin action history (org.restrict / org.lift / org.suspend events).
Move `data-testid="admin-audit-search"` to the Action input (or add `admin-audit-action`) and consider a shadcn-style calendar for the date filters.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the recurring 'Failed to execute json on Response: Unexpected end of JSON input' error is in apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts's `call<T>` helper: `return (await res.json()) as T;` runs on the success path regardless of body. NestJS handlers for `/api/admin/kyb/:orgId/review`, `/api/admin/orgs/:id/suspend|lift`, `/api/admin/users/:id/suspend|reactivate` respond 204 No Content, so `Response.json()` throws SyntaxError. That error propagates to the calling page's `catch` block, which shows `err.message` in an InlineAlert. Backend state DOES transition (verified via GET /admin/kyb-queue and /admin/audit). Fix: detect 204/empty body before parsing. Reproduction: (1) log in as demo.admin; (2) submit KYB for demo.supplier via `POST /api/orgs/:orgId/kyb/submit`; (3) open /admin/kyb, click the org, click Request correction, add a note, submit — user sees a red error alert, but re-navigating the queue shows the org with the 'Correction requested' label.
